claims.sectionKey: Сорок, девяносто y сто tienen dos tipos de forma: nominativo/acusativo y сорока/девяноста/ста para los casos oblicuos.
claims.summary: Russian numerals сорок, девяносто, and сто have two forms: nominative/acusative and сорока/девяноста/ста for oblique cases.

claims.sectionKey: El sustantivo acompañante sí se declina según el caso de toda la construcción.
claims.summary: The accompanying noun declines according to the case of the entire construction.

links.notes: The claim is supported by the Wikibooks reference entry on Russian numbers, which explicitly states that these numerals have two forms, one for nominative/acusative and another for oblique cases.
The same Wikibooks reference entry supports this claim, stating that the noun accompanying these numerals declines according to the case of the entire construction.
